2. With 3 sugar cane, I can now craft 3 pieces of paper.

4. Having gathered 1 sugar, I can now craft 1 oxeye daisy.
5. With both the required 1 paper and 1 oxeye daisy, I can craft the flower banner pattern using the formula: 1 paper + 1 oxeye daisy.
6. After crafting the flower banner pattern, I no longer need the oxeye daisy, so I can discard it or keep it for future use if needed.

1. Gather 3 sugar cane.
2. Craft 3 pieces of paper using 3 sugar cane.
3. Gather 1 sugar.
4. Craft 1 oxeye daisy using 1 sugar.
5. Craft the flower banner pattern using 1 paper and 1 oxeye daisy.

This strategy ensures all necessary items are gathered and combined in the correct order to achieve the goal of crafting the flower banner pattern.
